text.p: The Turkish lira eased to 87,350 to the dollar on Friday from Thursday's close of 87,110 on the central bank's higher dollar rate for banks' foreign exchange transfers and higher dollar/mark parity, bankers said.
The central bank set its dollar rate for banks' compulsory monthly currency transfers at 87,350 lira at the opening, and later pulled it down to 87,320.
The currency basket, composed 60 percent of marks and 40 percent of dollars, gained 1.05 percent against the lira this week, compared to 0.32 percent a week ago.

The overnight money rate closed at 74.75 percent after moving between 63-74.75 percent during the day. It eased to 63 percent in the morning, but gradually rose to 74.75 percent at close due to the cash demand ahead of the weekend.
The average o/n rate was 73.04 percent on Thursday.
In the t-bill market, the downtrend continued on t-bills with February, March 1997 maturities and their yields fell by one point. Others were little changed.
The average yield on the most heavily traded December 25 paper fell to 115.34 percent from 115.55 Thursday.
The second most active February 26 paper yielded 127.26 percent after 128.29 percent Thursday average.
